chunks: Al-Mufaḍḍal ibn ʿUmar narrated from Thābit al-Thumālī, from Ḥabābah al-Wālibiyyah, may Allah be pleased with her, who said:

I heard my master, Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام, saying: “Indeed, we are a household who do not drink intoxicants, do not eat al-jirrī, and do not wipe over the khuffs. So whoever is among our Shiʿah, let him follow our example and adhere to our sunnah (prophetic tradition).”

key_terms.أَهْلُ بَيْتٍ: the Household of the Prophet’s family, presented here as the model to be followed
key_terms.الْجِرِّيَّ: a type of fish identified here as not eaten
key_terms.الْخُفَّيْنِ: leather socks over which wiping is mentioned in wudu (ablution)
key_terms.بِسُنَّتِنَا: according to our sunnah (prophetic tradition), meaning their normative way
key_terms.شِيعَتِنَا: those who follow and adhere to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام

ai.seo_question: What practices does Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام instruct the Shiʿah to follow from the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: This hadith states practices attributed to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام in matters of lawful conduct and ritual practice. It instructs the Shiʿah to take them as their model and to adhere to their sunnah (prophetic tradition).

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5902 - Al-Mufaddal ibn Umar narrated from Thabit Al-Thumali from Hababah Al-Walibiyyah (may Allah (swt) be pleased with her) who said:

"I heard my master, the Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), say:
'Indeed, we are the Ahlul Bayt who do not drink intoxicants, do not eat catfish, and do not wipe over leather socks (in ablution).
So whoever is from our Shia should follow our example and adhere to our Sunnah.'"
